commentary:
1. SCORE & MOMENTUM
The Phoenix Suns hold a 65-59 lead over the Utah Jazz at halftime. After trailing by one point following the first quarter, Phoenix seized control in the second frame with a 35-28 surge, generating an 8-point momentum shift. 

2. KEY PLAYER ANALYSIS
Utah star Lauri Markkanen leads all featured scorers with 15 points, while Phoenix star Devin Booker has contributed 12 points and 4 assists. Booker's playmaking has helped offset his scoring deficit against Markkanen, while Markkanen received zero assists in the first half.

3. X-FACTORS / FOUL TROUBLE
Despite Utah shooting a higher overall field goal percentage at 0.463 compared to Phoenix's 0.455, the Suns are dominating from beyond the arc by shooting 0.476 on three-pointers. Phoenix is also capitalizing on second-chance opportunities with a 0.273 offensive rebounding percentage, contributing to a plus-5 rebound differential. Utah currently has two starters with three or more fouls, compared to just one for Phoenix.

4. SECOND-HALF OUTLOOK
The Phoenix Suns are firmly on track to secure a victory, backed by a strong offensive showing that includes a 0.626 true shooting percentage and 22 bench points. Phoenix will control the remainder of this matchup to finish ahead by a predicted 8-point margin.
